body:
## Pull request overview

This PR completes remaining P5 “Mobile User Experience” roadmap items across the console app and multiple renderer/plugins, focusing on touch ergonomics, pull-to-refresh, PWA scaffolding, and mobile-focused E2E coverage.

**Changes:**
- Added `@object-ui/mobile` usage across Grid/List/Calendar (pull-to-refresh) and Console root (`MobileProvider`) plus a new PWA manifest link/file.
- Improved mobile touch targets/responsive sizing for form controls and WizardForm stepper visuals; added DataTable horizontal-scroll indicator.
- Added Playwright mobile viewport E2E coverage and marked corresponding ROADMAP items complete.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 17 out of 18 changed files in this pull request and generated 10 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds workspace links for `@object-ui/mobile` in relevant importers. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Integrates pull-to-refresh via `usePullToRefresh` and triggers refetch via `refreshKey`. |
| packages/plugin-list/package.json | Adds `@object-ui/mobile` dependency. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Integrates pull-to-refresh via `usePullToRefresh` and triggers reload via `refreshKey`. |
| packages/plugin-grid/package.json | Adds `@object-ui/mobile` dependency. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx | Tweaks stepper sizing/spacing for mobile. |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx | Integrates pull-to-refresh and refresh-driven refetch. |
| packages/plugin-calendar/package.json | Adds `@object-ui/mobile` dependency. |
| packages/fields/src/widgets/SignatureField.tsx | Adds `loading="lazy"` to readonly signature image. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/layout/aspect-ratio.tsx | Adds `loading="lazy"` to rendered image. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx | Adds mobile touch target sizing and responsive label text. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Adds inset shadow as horizontal-scroll indicator. |
| e2e/mobile-viewport.spec.ts | Adds Playwright mobile viewport checks (errors, blank page, viewport/manifest, overflow, touch target sampling). |
| apps/console/src/main.tsx | Wraps app root in `MobileProvider` with PWA config. |
| apps/console/public/manifest.json | Adds a PWA manifest for Console. |
| apps/console/package.json | Adds `@object-ui/mobile` dependency (plus minor ordering). |
| apps/console/index.html | Links the manifest. |
| ROADMAP.md | Checks off P5 mobile UX items after audit. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

`MobileProvider`'s `pwa` prop is typed as `PWAConfig`, which requires an `enabled: boolean` field. The object passed here omits `enabled`, which will fail TypeScript type-checking and makes the configuration ambiguous. Add `enabled: true` (or pass a complete `PWAConfig`).

Same issue for `Checkbox`/`Switch`: `className` is specified before the `...checkboxProps` / `...switchProps` spread, so any incoming `className` from the field config can override the touch-target sizing classes. Merge class names or ensure the touch-target classes are always included when spreading props.

`usePullToRefresh` requires the ref element to be the scroll container (it checks `el.scrollTop`). Here the ref is attached to a non-scrollable wrapper (no `overflow-auto`), so `scrollTop` will always be `0` and pull-to-refresh can trigger even when the user isn’t at the top of the actual scroller (likely a parent container). Consider attaching `pullRef` to a scrollable container (e.g., add `overflow-auto h-full` like `ObjectTimeline`).

Unused import: `devices` is imported but never used. Remove it to keep the test file clean and avoid unused-import warnings in editors/linters.
```suggestion
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
```

This test’s wording doesn’t match the actual thresholds: the test name says “≥ 44px” but `MINIMUM_TOUCH_TARGET_PX` is `32`, and the comment mentions 80% but `MINIMUM_TOUCH_TARGET_COMPLIANCE` is `0.7`. Update the test name/comments (or the constants) so failures are interpreted correctly.

The `className` you add for the 44px touch target can be overwritten by `...fileProps` / `...fieldProps` because the spread comes after `className`. If the schema provides `className`, it will replace the touch-target classes and regress mobile UX. Merge/append class names (e.g., via `cn`) or move the spread before the `className` prop so both are preserved.

`usePullToRefresh` expects the `ref` to be attached to the *scrollable container* (it checks `el.scrollTop === 0`). This wrapper div doesn't appear to be scrollable (no `overflow-auto`), so `scrollTop` will remain `0` and pull-to-refresh can trigger even when the actual scrollable content (DataTable) is scrolled. Consider attaching the ref to the element that actually scrolls, or make this container the scroll container (similar to `ObjectTimeline`’s `overflow-auto h-full`).

`usePullToRefresh`’s `ref` should point to the scrollable container (it relies on `scrollTop` to decide when a refresh is allowed). This root container uses flex layout and the content area is `overflow-hidden`, so it’s likely *not* the scrolling element; `scrollTop` will stay `0` and refresh may trigger while scrolled inside child views / parent containers. Attach the ref to the actual scrolling element or make the ListView content container scrollable (e.g., `overflow-auto`).

The comment says the inset shadow is a “horizontal scroll indicator … on mobile”, but the class applies at all breakpoints. If it should only be visible on small screens, add responsive modifiers (e.g., disable it at `sm:`+) or adjust the comment to reflect the actual behavior.
```suggestion
      {/* Table - horizontal scroll indicator via inset shadow */}
```

The manifest currently declares only a single SVG icon (`/vite.svg`). Some platforms (notably iOS home-screen installs) have limited/variable support for SVG manifest icons and often expect PNG sizes. Consider adding PNG icons (e.g., 192x192, 512x512) and optionally `purpose: "maskable"` for better install experience.
```suggestion
      "purpose": "any"
    },
    {
      "src": "/icons/icon-192x192.png",
      "sizes": "192x192",
      "type": "image/png",
      "purpose": "any"
    },
    {
      "src": "/icons/icon-512x512.png",
      "sizes": "512x512",
      "type": "image/png",
      "purpose": "any"
    },
    {
      "src": "/icons/maskable-icon-512x512.png",
      "sizes": "512x512",
      "type": "image/png",
      "purpose": "maskable"
```
